name: Boku no Tomodachi wa Atama ga Okashii.
original_name: 僕のトモダチは頭がおかしい。
source:
I held up the metal bat, swung, and dropped it due to gravity.

A grotesque sound echoed. Blood and flesh splatter.

And I,

yeah I,

-- I killed my classmate.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6580]NovelGame[/url]]
